name: dataset-masker
description: Make a safe copy of a spreadsheet with personal data before you hand it to an outsourcer, a vendor or an AI tool. Names, phone numbers, emails, ID and bank card numbers, addresses and birthdays are found automatically; choose per column to mask part of it (138****1234), hash it, replace it with a consistent pseudonym (用户0001), coarsen it (just the city, just the year), clean phone numbers and emails out of free-text notes, or drop the column. It warns if anything personal is still left. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Make a safe copy of a spreadsheet with personal data before you hand it to an outsourcer, a vendor or an AI tool. It warns if anything personal is still left. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把含个人信息的表格交给外包、供应商或 AI 工具之前，先做一份安全的副本。自动识别姓名、手机号、邮箱、身份证号、银行卡号、地址和生日；每列可选：部分遮盖（138****1234）、哈希、替换成一致的化名（用户0001）、泛化（只留城市、只留年份）、清除备注里夹带的手机号和邮箱，或直接删除该列。如果还有个人信息残留会提醒你。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
